correctness.rationale: Stationary Gaussian-mixture representation is exact by conditioning on common Poisson or Brownian environmental histories. Generator identities establish necessity of positive order-p decay and moment product, Minkowski integral bounds show sufficiency; a Taylor third-derivative remainder gives strict gap, and the uniform simple-root perturbation gives O(1/s) order counts. Exact rational checker and reproducible Monte Carlo support key evaluations.
